description: This file defines the ReportingMethodConfigurationDao class, which manages database operations related to reporting methods in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It includes methods for saving, retrieving by ID or name, listing with pagination, counting, deleting, and checking for existing reporting methods, plus fetching IDs in use.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling reporting method entities, provides CRUD operations, filtering, pagination, and utility methods for reporting methods in the application.

methods.name: saveReportingMethod
methods.description: Persists a ReportingMethod entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getReportingMethodById
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod entity by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Finds a ReportingMethod entity by its name.

methods.name: getReportingMethodListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of ReportingMethod entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of ReportingMethod entities matching the search filters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ReportingMethod entities matching the search filters.

methods.name: deleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Deletes ReportingMethod entities by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingReportingMethodName
methods.description: Checks if a reporting method name already exists.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdsInUse
methods.description: Returns an array of reporting method IDs that are currently in use.
